source.text_it: Negli intervalli tra una sostituzione e l’altra del lubrificante, il suo livello va controllato ad intervalli regolari e rabboccato in caso di necessità

records.localized_text: Between oil changes, check the level regularly and top up if needed.

source.text_it: Il lubrificante protegge dalla corrosione le parti metalliche su cui si deposita

records.localized_text: Lubricant protects metal surfaces it coats against corrosion.

source.text_it: L’olio "multigrado" è più stabile nei cambiamenti di temperatura ambiente (estate-inverno o inverno-estate)

records.localized_text: Multigrade oil is more stable under seasonal ambient temperature changes.

source.text_it: Un indicatore di pressione ed una spia luminosa di colore rosso, posti sulla plancia portastrumenti, permettono di tenere sotto controllo lo stato dell’impianto di lubrificazione

records.localized_text: A dashboard pressure indicator and red warning light allow monitoring of the lubrication system.

source.text_it: Se dal tubo di scarico di un motore Diesel esce fumo chiaro, ciò può significare che il motore brucia olio che è trafilato nei cilindri

records.localized_text: Light-colored diesel exhaust smoke may mean the engine is burning oil that leaked into the cylinders.

source.text_it: Se durante la marcia si accende la spia della lubrificazione, significa che la pressione nell’impianto è troppo bassa ed insufficiente a garantire il corretto funzionamento del motore

records.localized_text: If the lubrication warning light comes on while driving, system pressure is too low to ensure correct engine operation.

source.text_it: Sull’asta graduata per il controllo del liquido di lubrificazione sono indicati i livelli minimo e massimo che deve avere l’olio nella coppa

records.localized_text: The lubrication dipstick shows minimum and maximum oil levels for the sump.

source.text_it: Generalmente, ad ogni cambio dell’olio è bene sostituire anche la cartuccia del relativo filtro

records.localized_text: Generally, the corresponding filter cartridge should also be replaced at each oil change.

source.text_it: E' bene non usare nei motori Diesel olio specifico per motori a scoppio e viceversa

records.localized_text: Diesel-specific oil should not be used in spark-ignition engines or vice versa.

source.text_it: E' consigliabile sostituire l’olio per la lubrificazione del motore secondo le tempistiche e percorrenze raccomandate dal costruttore del motore stesso

records.localized_text: Engine lubricating oil should be changed at the time and distance intervals recommended by the engine manufacturer.

source.text_it: Gli olii lubrificanti possono contenere additivi chimici

records.localized_text: Lubricating oils may contain chemical additives.

source.text_it: Gli olii lubrificanti possono essere minerali o sintetici

records.localized_text: Lubricating oils may be mineral or synthetic.

source.text_it: Una delle principali trasformazioni che subiscono gli olii lubrificanti durante l’uso è il cambio di viscosità

records.localized_text: A major change lubricating oils undergo during use is a change in viscosity.

source.text_it: Una delle principali trasformazioni che subiscono gli olii lubrificanti durante l’uso è l’ossidazione

records.localized_text: A major change lubricating oils undergo during use is oxidation.

source.text_it: Una delle principali trasformazioni che subiscono gli olii lubrificanti durante l’uso è l’aumento di acidità

records.localized_text: A major change lubricating oils undergo during use is increased acidity.

source.text_it: Uno degli scopi dell'impianto di lubrificazione di un motore è quello di contribuire al raffreddamento dei vari organi in movimento

records.localized_text: One purpose of an engine lubrication system is to help cool moving components.

source.text_it: Uno degli scopi dell'impianto di lubrificazione di un motore è quello di interporre un velo d’olio tra le parti del motore e le parti in movimento

records.localized_text: One purpose of an engine lubrication system is to place an oil film between engine parts and moving parts.

source.text_it: Uno degli scopi dell'impianto di lubrificazione di un motore è quello di ridurre l’usura degli organi in movimento all’interno del motore

records.localized_text: One purpose of an engine lubrication system is to reduce wear of moving components inside the engine.

source.text_it: Uno degli scopi dell'impianto di lubrificazione di un motore è quello di ridurre l’attrito delle parti in movimento del motore

records.localized_text: One purpose of an engine lubrication system is to reduce friction of moving engine parts.

source.text_it: La pompa ad ingranaggi del sistema di lubrificazione di un motore mette in circolazione l’olio lubrificante sotto pressione

records.localized_text: An engine lubrication gear pump circulates pressurized lubricating oil.

source.text_it: Se si accende la spia dell'olio, oppure il manometro segna una pressione bassa, la pompa ad ingranaggi potrebbe essere guasta o difettosa

records.localized_text: If the oil warning light comes on or the pressure gauge reads low, the gear pump may be faulty.

source.text_it: Se si accende la spia dell'olio, oppure il manometro segna una pressione bassa, la valvola limitatrice della pressione può essere guasta o il filtro può essere intasato

records.localized_text: If the oil warning light comes on or the pressure gauge reads low, the pressure relief valve may be faulty or the filter clogged.

source.text_it: Se si accende la spia dell'olio, oppure il manometro segna una pressione bassa, la quantità d’olio presente nel circuito potrebbe essere troppo scarsa

records.localized_text: If the oil warning light comes on or the pressure gauge reads low, the circuit may contain too little oil.

source.text_it: L’olio esausto deve essere conferito (portato) ad un soggetto appartenente ad uno specifico consorzio

records.localized_text: Used oil must be delivered to an entity belonging to a specific consortium.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel si può usare qualunque tipo di olio, l’importante è che sia sufficientemente viscoso

records.localized_text: Any sufficiently viscous oil may be used in a diesel engine.

rows.text: The level can fall during use. Checking it regularly and topping up with the specified oil when needed helps keep it between the prescribed marks.
evidence: Volvo S80 2009 owner manual, Engine oil, https://www.volvocars.com/images/cs/v3/assets/bltccbab8edae0354cd/blt8e3c1c175362a784/68596631c4877563e5612dfb/S80_OM_US_MY09-web.pdf — check regularly, keep between MIN and MAX and add specified oil.

rows.text: The oil film and protective additives help shield metal surfaces from agents that cause corrosion.
evidence: Shell, Lubricants FAQ, https://www.shell.com/motorist/oils-lubricants/faq.html — oil film reduces friction and wear, removes heat and protects against corrosion; oil contains base oils and additives.

rows.text: Multigrade oil is formulated to flow when cold and maintain suitable viscosity when hot; its viscosity still changes with temperature.
evidence: Bartz, SAE paper 890728, https://doi.org/10.4271/890728 — multigrade oils formulated for viscosity requirements at low and high temperatures using mineral or synthetic base oils.

rows.text: The gauge shows oil pressure; the red light warns of potentially insufficient pressure. They are monitoring signals, not a complete diagnosis.
evidence: Volvo S60 2023 manual, Low oil pressure, p. 328, https://www.volvocars.com/static/support-content/pdfs/ca_en-US_s60_2023_UM_65681f803d9a4713280f23b1dcd93581.pdf — red oil symbol warns of potentially low pressure; stop driving.
Cummins CFP83 troubleshooting p. 12-91, https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0057258.pdf — gauge and low pressure light indicate low pressure; an indication can be faulty.

rows.text: Light smoke with a blue tint can accompany oil consumption when, for example, the piston rings do not seal. Color alone cannot identify the cause with certainty.
evidence: Cummins CFP83 troubleshooting, p. 12-87, https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0057258.pdf — excessive oil consumption and blue smoke can accompany piston rings failing to seal; Perkins https://www.perkins.com/en_GB/blog/Troubleshooting-Engine-Problems-and-Preventative-Maintenance-Tips.html lists oil burning among possible causes of exhaust smoke.

rows.text: The red light warns that oil pressure may be too low for proper lubrication. Stop and switch off the engine; the cause must be checked.
evidence: Volvo S60 2023 manual, Low oil pressure, p. 328, https://www.volvocars.com/static/support-content/pdfs/ca_en-US_s60_2023_UM_65681f803d9a4713280f23b1dcd93581.pdf — red oil symbol warns of potentially low pressure; stop driving.

rows.text: The dipstick has MIN and MAX marks. The reading should be between them, following the manufacturer’s procedure.
evidence: Volvo S80 2009 owner manual, Engine oil, https://www.volvocars.com/images/cs/v3/assets/bltccbab8edae0354cd/blt8e3c1c175362a784/68596631c4877563e5612dfb/S80_OM_US_MY09-web.pdf — check regularly, keep between MIN and MAX and add specified oil.

rows.text: The filter traps contaminants. Replacing it with the oil avoids leaving a filter loaded with impurities in service. Follow the manufacturer’s intervals.
evidence: Cummins CFP8E troubleshooting, p. 17-84, https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0057319.pdf — blocked oil filter or malfunctioning relief valve can cause low pressure; change oil and filter.

Perkins 402D-05G maintenance, https://www.perkins.com/en_GB/products/new/perkins/electric-power-generation/diesel-engines/1000002513.html — oil and filter share a service interval in this engine; Caterpillar 610-0035, https://parts.cat.com/en/catcorp/product/610-0035 — engine oil filter removes dirt and impurities.

rows.text: Choose the specification required by the manufacturer for that engine; do not automatically interchange oils intended for different uses. Some oils meet both diesel and gasoline specifications.
evidence: API Motor Oil Guide, https://www.api.org/~/media/Files/Certification/Engine-Oil-Diesel/Publications/2019%20EOLCS%20Motor%20Oil%20Guide.pdf — use manufacturer-recommended viscosity and performance category; some oils meet both diesel and gasoline categories; follow oil change recommendations.

rows.text: Oil degrades and collects contaminants in use; the manufacturer’s time and distance intervals determine when to replace it.
evidence: API Motor Oil Guide, https://www.api.org/~/media/Files/Certification/Engine-Oil-Diesel/Publications/2019%20EOLCS%20Motor%20Oil%20Guide.pdf — use manufacturer-recommended viscosity and performance category; some oils meet both diesel and gasoline categories; follow oil change recommendations.

rows.text: Substances can be added to the base oil to improve functions such as oxidation resistance and wear protection.
evidence: Shell Rotella, How Oil Additives Work, https://rotella.shell.com/en_us/info-hub/diesel-oil-guide/how-oil-additives-work.html — oxidation produces organic acids and can increase viscosity; antioxidants slow degradation.

rows.text: Oils can be formulated with mineral or synthetic base oils; the choice for an engine depends on the required specifications.
evidence: Bartz, SAE paper 890728, https://doi.org/10.4271/890728 — multigrade oils formulated for viscosity requirements at low and high temperatures using mineral or synthetic base oils.

rows.text: Oxidation in service can increase viscosity, the oil’s resistance to flow, changing its lubrication behavior.
evidence: Shell Rotella, How Oil Additives Work, https://rotella.shell.com/en_us/info-hub/diesel-oil-guide/how-oil-additives-work.html — oxidation produces organic acids and can increase viscosity; antioxidants slow degradation.

rows.text: In use, oil reacts with oxygen and degrades. Antioxidants slow this process but do not eliminate it.
evidence: Shell Rotella, How Oil Additives Work, https://rotella.shell.com/en_us/info-hub/diesel-oil-guide/how-oil-additives-work.html — oxidation produces organic acids and can increase viscosity; antioxidants slow degradation.

rows.text: Oxidation can produce organic acids in oil; their accumulation contributes to lubricant deterioration.
evidence: Shell Rotella, How Oil Additives Work, https://rotella.shell.com/en_us/info-hub/diesel-oil-guide/how-oil-additives-work.html — oxidation produces organic acids and can increase viscosity; antioxidants slow degradation.

rows.text: Circulating oil absorbs heat from hot areas and carries it elsewhere, helping cool components.
evidence: Shell, Lubricants FAQ, https://www.shell.com/motorist/oils-lubricants/faq.html — oil film reduces friction and wear, removes heat and protects against corrosion; oil contains base oils and additives.

rows.text: The system delivers oil between surfaces in relative motion: the film separates them and limits direct contact.
evidence: Shell, Lubricants FAQ, https://www.shell.com/motorist/oils-lubricants/faq.html — oil film reduces friction and wear, removes heat and protects against corrosion; oil contains base oils and additives.

rows.text: The lubricating film limits contact between moving surfaces and thus reduces wear.
evidence: Shell, Lubricants FAQ, https://www.shell.com/motorist/oils-lubricants/faq.html — oil film reduces friction and wear, removes heat and protects against corrosion; oil contains base oils and additives.

rows.text: The oil film separates surfaces sliding against each other, reducing friction compared with direct contact.
evidence: Shell, Lubricants FAQ, https://www.shell.com/motorist/oils-lubricants/faq.html — oil film reduces friction and wear, removes heat and protects against corrosion; oil contains base oils and additives.

rows.text: The pump circulates pressurized oil through the system to supply the points requiring lubrication.
evidence: Caterpillar 243-4304, https://parts.cat.com/en/catcorp/product/243-4304 — oil pump circulates and pressurizes oil for engine lubrication; attributes include gear-pump design.

rows.text: A faulty pump can compromise oil pressure. The light or gauge signals the problem but does not identify its cause on its own.
evidence: Cummins CFP11E troubleshooting, p. 12-86, https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0057337.pdf — malfunctioning oil pump or relief valve among low-pressure causes.

rows.text: A faulty relief valve or a clogged filter can contribute to low pressure; both are possible causes to check.
evidence: Cummins CFP8E troubleshooting, p. 17-84, https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0057319.pdf — blocked oil filter or malfunctioning relief valve can cause low pressure; change oil and filter.

rows.text: If there is too little oil, the pump may not supply the circuit properly and pressure can fall. Check the level as directed in the manual.
evidence: Volvo S80 2009 owner manual, Engine oil, https://www.volvocars.com/images/cs/v3/assets/bltccbab8edae0354cd/blt8e3c1c175362a784/68596631c4877563e5612dfb/S80_OM_US_MY09-web.pdf — check regularly, keep between MIN and MAX and add specified oil.
Cummins CFP59 troubleshooting p. 12-80, https://mart.cummins.com/imagelibrary/data/assetfiles/0057353.pdf — low oil level is a possible cause of low pressure; check and replenish.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE: delivery through the consortium network is one route for used mineral oil. It is not the only one: it can also go to an authorized waste handler outside consortium management; the law also allows transfer to businesses in other EU states.
evidence: D.Lgs. 152/2006, art. 236 comma 15, come riportato in AGCM, Bollettino 30/2024, provvedimento A569, par. 96, https://www.agcm.it/dotcmsdoc/bollettini/2024/30-24.pdf — conferimento al consorzio direttamente o tramite incaricati o soggetti autorizzati; prevista anche la cessione a imprese di altri Stati UE.

AGCM, stesso provvedimento, paragrafi 97–101, pp. 27–28 — CONOU e MASE confermano la compatibilità del conferimento a terzi autorizzati fuori dalla gestione consortile; il MASE esclude un obbligo automatico di conferimento al solo CONOU. Il quiz stampa VERO, ma la formulazione può suggerire un’esclusività non prevista.

rows.text: Viscosity alone is not enough: a diesel engine also needs oil meeting the performance specifications and grade indicated by its manufacturer.
evidence: API Motor Oil Guide, https://www.api.org/~/media/Files/Certification/Engine-Oil-Diesel/Publications/2019%20EOLCS%20Motor%20Oil%20Guide.pdf — use manufacturer-recommended viscosity and performance category; some oils meet both diesel and gasoline categories; follow oil change recommendations.
